reviews.title: 40 Years Later, Still Connected
reviews.text:
When we started planning our 40th Ridgewood High School reunion, we wanted an easy way to bring everything  together - from sharing weekend details and hotel information to selling tickets for our reunion celebration.

That’s where GroupSpot came in and it turned out to be so much more than we expected! We were able to share important information in one place, create a group chat for updates throughout the weekend, and give everyone a place to share their favorite photos and memories.

Even after our reunion, classmates are still joining GroupSpot because they want to stay connected. It also gave us an easy way to collect and maintain updated contact information, which will be very useful when we start planning our 45th reunion.

GroupSpot made planning and staying connected so much easier. It truly made our 40th reunion weekend a resounding success!

reviews.title: GroupSpot Streamlines communications, community and payments for Don Bosco Touchdown Club
reviews.text: GroupSpot has been an outstanding tool for running our large Touchdown Club at Don Bosco Prep. It streamlined communication, making it easy for members to stay informed and find everything they need in one place. The platform created a strong sense of community by helping families stay connected, engaged, and supportive of one another. The payments feature was especially valuable for managing tickets, merchandise, tailgates, player meals, and dues—keeping everything organized, easy to track, and reducing confusion for both members and volunteers.

reviews.title: The Ultimate Tool!
reviews.text:
"As a high school band director at Williamsville South with 30+ years of experience, I can honestly say GroupSpot is a total game-changer. We recently used it for our trip to Universal Orlando, and it was the most organized our communication has ever been. From creating attendance rosters with emergency info to posting daily itineraries and sending quick SMS updates, it handled everything brilliantly. The shared photo albums were a huge hit with parents at home!

Beyond the trip, we use GroupSpot in our program year-round. We have separate groups for each ensemble to keep communication streamlined and focused. My colleagues have even started adopting it for their own programs after seeing how much it has simplified our lives. It’s user-friendly, brilliantly designed, and I truly don't know how we managed before this. Highly recommended!"

reviews.title: Great Team Management Tool
reviews.text: We use GroupSpot to manage our high school football team.  Being able to run our team calendar, send real time updates and have chat all under one central platform is huge for us.  Having separate chats by position groups, individuals or the team as a whole cuts down on redundant emails which many times go unread. Being able to upload photo and video clips are a huge help during game week prep. I’ve used other apps and GroupSpot by far has been the best option for us!

reviews.title: Ridgewood Soccer Association

Through admins managing our practice/game schedules, coaches providing up-to-date info to their teams, players happily chatting & posting pictures, even parents organizing snacks, our communication has been streamlined. GroupSpot is also intuitive and super easy to use, but if needed, the support is fantastic. GroupSpot helped to forge a stronger sense of community within our organization, and we’re grateful!

reviews.title: Stop the painful email searches!

And trying to find them when you need them - who did that one come from?  Painful.  Not with GroupSpot.  This app makes it SO easy to find, track and manage all of your (and yours kids’) stuff.  Everything is organized.  Besides a main page, it has a calendar, a chat feature (no more annoying group texts!) a sign-up capability, alerts.  All in one place.  Don’t know how I’d manage without it!

reviews.title: Amazing way to communicate
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Outstanding communication support for our summer music camp
reviews.text: Cannon Music Camp at Appalachian State University had our inaugural year using GroupSpot this past summer, 2025.  Over the 57 years of camp we’ve certainly invented and re-invented many ways to communicated and support our music campers during the three-week experience.  We found that GroupSpot, had many features that worked tremendously well for our communication needs.  The feed experience, the ability to share photos, and the ability to reach out to students via the app without utilizing their personal numbers was exceptional.  For our purposes we created a daily announcement slide on Canva and linked it a a news feed update.  We also liked the ability to add our concerts to the calendar and be able to upload photos to each event so that we have a much better way to sort through photos post-camp to use for promotion in social media.  The attendance features of GroupSpot were also helpful for us in many ways.  The very best part about using GroupSpot was the exceptional support we as a staff received from John and how GroupSpot is really listening to suggestions for improvement or update that can help make the app work even better for a summer camp as opposed to an athletic program or school music program.

Planning ahead of our trip and communicating with travelers and their families during travel was easy and convenient. Tons of features like attendance, photo albums, forms, payment gathering, emergency contacts, chat groups, push notifications to specific groups... the list goes on. Tech support was also fantastic whenever we needed help. Definitely recommend!

reviews.title: No better app for your group event
reviews.text: I am the Class President  for a class at a liberal arts college in New England. A classmate asked me if we could find an app for our reunion that would make it easier to communicate between classmates during the weekend- messaging and sharing photos- and to find scheduled events on campus for people who hadn’t been back for decades. GroupSpot fulfilled both those duties flawlessly and in post reunion feedback, was consistently rated one of the coolest parts of the reunion. We showed it off to classes older and younger than ours and everyone was incredibly jealous and now wants to use it for their next reunion. If you are looking for a plug and play app for a reunion or other kind of event, I cannot imagine a better solution than GroupSpot.

reviews.title: Very efficient group communication tool
reviews.text: We used the GroupSpot app to communicate with our 8th grade parents over the course of the year while fundraising and planning our graduation celebration.  I am not a “tech savvy” person by any means and I had no problems being an administrator of the group.  It was so nice to have all of the communication in one spot- no need to search through emails to find information that you need to refer back to.  We also used the app for sign-ups, surveys, and RSVP’s as well, and we also were able to share pictures and videos on the app.  The calendar was very helpful to us too, allowing parents to sync it to their phones and enabling us to send automatic reminders about events.  I would definitely recommend GroupSpot to anyone looking to streamline communication within their group.

reviews.title: So useful and easy!
reviews.text:
After being a part of this knitting  group for the past two years, I can confidently say that GroupSpot has been a game changer! I’ve been part of the group for a while, and as a busy knitter juggling my projects and daily life, I truly appreciate how much easier it has made staying connected and engaged.

The group holds several sessions a week where we can drop in and get help with our knitting projects—so helpful! With my busy schedule, it’s great to have a place where I can always check for updates and join sessions at the last minute if needed. The best part? The calendar is always up-to-date, and I get quick notifications when something changes, which is a huge relief.

There’s also an active group chat, a monthly shared photo album where we can share finished projects, and a growing library of instructional videos. But what stands out the most to me is how easy it is to be part of this group. It's so simple to use—no tech headaches here!

Apps should be intuitive and make things easier, and GroupSpot does just that. It really streamlines everything, from session updates to socializing with other knitters. It’s amazing how much more efficient everything has become, and I honestly can’t believe I ever dealt with all of this through email before. If you're looking for an easy way to stay organized and engaged in a community, GroupSpot is the way to go!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ | Game-Changer for Communication!

We used GroupSpot this summer at Eastern Music Festival to streamline admin-to-student communications, and it was an absolute game-changer! The app made it effortless to keep everyone informed, organized, and on the same page throughout our busy festival season.  

From sharing updates and schedules to sending reminders and announcements, GroupSpot was intuitive, reliable, and fast. It saved us so much time and eliminated confusion…honestly, we can’t imagine managing the summer without it!  

If you're looking for a seamless way to enhance communication within your organization or event, GroupSpot is a must-have. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Outstanding for any Group Communication
reviews.text: I am a high school head football coach (Glen Rock HS, NJ ) and we needed a direct means of communication and info to players. GroupSpot delivers and is top notch with many features that will help the needs of your organization. It is simple, yet has a vast amount of other tools that are user friendly. You can post updates that will be a direct notification, or you can time to when you’d like a message out. You can also create mini groups if you want to send a message to a smaller group, or a personal convo with someone. One of my favorite features is the custom ability of making the platform friendly to your group (i.e. logos), and you can see who viewed your update (which is great for accountability). We also put our calendar on this, and you can send reminders of a certain event pushed directly to their phones. There’s many more features to also navigate. They also have excellent customer service and will help you with any issues. I highly recommend this especially if you are a coach of a HS or a club sport!

reviews.title: All the Messages in 1️⃣ Place
reviews.text:
As a parent in HS / College competitive swimming and an officer in my teacher’s union, I was frustrated by my text message notifications dinging all day and emails getting lost in the multiple spam messages…enter GroupSpot. 

I am pretty picky when it comes to using a new platform. Working as a tech integration specialist I have one rule - if I can’t figure out how to use a new tool in less than 10 minutes I’m out.  GroupSpot not only met that rule but exceeded it. So easy to set up and more importantly - really easy to get users onboarded GroupSpot got over 300 teachers connected in a matter of a week and streamlined our communication making messaging so much more effective. After using it for less than a month, I started a new group for the parent group for my daughter’s swim team. Same easy setup, same easy response! I cannot recommend it enough and look forward to the next group I can build  ❤️
